sprints.title: v3.3.0
sprints.goals: This sprint focused on enhancing system reliability and user experience by modernizing infrastructure components, resolving critical communication and data integrity issues, and expanding mobile application functionality. The team also worked to improve security controls and ensure accurate data synchronization across platform systems.
sprints.summary: The team completed 20 significant improvements spanning infrastructure upgrades, backend enhancements, and user-facing features. Key accomplishments include upgrading MongoDB and .NET environments to current versions, resolving daylight savings time calculation errors, implementing Employee ID field integration across user profiles and registration workflows, and addressing critical issues with role management and notification delivery systems. Mobile Check-In now accepts spelled-out numbers and includes an Admin Leave option, while the platform now correctly handles phone verification and excludes read-only managers from unnecessary notifications. These changes collectively strengthen system stability, improve data accuracy in reporting, and provide users with a more intuitive and reliable experience.

sprints.title: v3.3.1.0
sprints.goals: This sprint focused on improving system stability and user experience across critical operational workflows, particularly around employee management, notification handling, and administrative visibility. The team also strengthened the foundation of lookup and reference data management to prevent data integrity issues.
sprints.summary: The team resolved several high-impact bugs affecting core workflows: fixed null reference exceptions in notifications, corrected the employee transfers navigation error, and eliminated duplicate role assignments while preventing invalid transfer requests. Additionally, the sprint delivered meaningful user-facing improvements including timezone-aware check-in scheduling based on local time, enhanced role assignment UI to distinguish active and inactive statuses, and better visibility of pending transfers in home page alerts. Backend improvements included optimizing Twilio webhook filtering to reduce database load, correcting sort order issues across rank classification lookups, and implementing email verification for notification settings. The work also ensured data quality in employee synchronization by updating user records with Employee ID identifiers, establishing a more reliable foundation for downstream system integrations.
